context: Naoko's ramen shop, after closing on her birthday. Mei has come down from Tokyo to see her. The shop is empty and warm.
purpose: aunt-style birthday — quiet warmth between two unrelated women who chose each other

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: なおこさん、お誕生日おめでとう。
lines.style: Soft entrance with flowers in the voice. Careful, genuine smile held steady. Present and unhurried.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: えっ…うっそ、メイちゃん、来てくれたん？
lines.en: What — no way, Mei-chan, you came?
lines.style: Genuine shock hitting first. A beat of disbelief. Hands pause mid-motion in the voice — towel caught mid-wipe.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん。本当に、来たかった。
lines.en: Yeah. I really wanted to come.
lines.style: Small, honest line delivered steadily. No performance. Just the truth, said plainly and with quiet certainty.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: Oh come on… you're going to make me cry…
lines.style: Half-laughing to hold back the real thing. The laugh cracks first, then she touches her eyes in the voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: いつもありがとう。本当に。
lines.style: A quiet bow sits inside the voice. Eyes wet. Said with full weight and no rush.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 座って座って。今日は、私が、ご飯作るで。
lines.en: Sit down, sit down. Today — I'm cooking for you.
lines.style: Full Kansai warmth takes over. Doesn't question, doesn't defer. Generous command wrapped in dialect.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: Half-protest, half-laugh. Genuine confusion underneath. Tries to resist but without real force.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 誕生日やから、私が作りたいねん。
lines.en: Because it's my birthday — I want to cook for you.
lines.style: Simple Kansai logic delivered with full-warmth philosophy. A small sentence that holds the whole truth.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: A small surrender, genuinely amused. Settles into the chair. Releases the protest with grace.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 一緒に食べる時間、本当に、いちばんの誕生日プレゼント。
lines.en: Eating together like this — this time together is my best birthday gift.
lines.style: Unguarded and real. A quiet philosophical moment, held steady. Present and attentive in every word.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: The smallest line of the night. Voice catches gently halfway through. Said to the moment, not away from it.
